server.description: The factory's library: chosen documents on scrubbers, air, measurement methods, CO2 and people, and the installation, to look a number or a method up rather than guess it; and the reference graphs of the station, each with its words, for a harness to instantiate on the twin
server.instructions: List the catalogue, search it with a few words, read a document whole. Every document is a file of the repository with its sha256; what is read is in the broker's trace.

list.title: The catalogue
list.description: Every document of the library: id, title, a summary, the quantities a method card measures, sha256 and size.

justify.title: What justifies a number
justify.description: What justifies a number you set, from the library rather than composed: give the constant's path (steps.2.speedPercent, limits.co2MaxPpm) and its value. It answers whether it is a safety constant (only a fact of a signed document justifies it, on its safe side), the facts the signed rules bound it by, each with its side, its signature and whether your value respects it, and the justification to write when one holds (copy it as it is); for any other constant, the sources that may justify it. Ask it for every number before you submit, several in one answer.

properties.constant: the path of the constant in what you submit, as the guard names it
properties.range: for bounds, [min, max] instead of value

methods.title: Methods that measure a quantity
methods.description: The method cards of the library that measure the given quantity (Volume, AirChange, VolumetricFlow...): id, title, summary, what each measures. A card holds the method's principle and its rules of application; read it with read.

properties.quantity: the quantity to measure, as the inventory names it

search.title: Search the library
search.description: The documents the query's words appear in, the most matched first, with the lines they appear on. Read a document whole with read.

properties.query: a few words: a quantity, a method, a device, a limit
properties.limit: how many documents at most (5 when absent)

facts.title: The typed facts
facts.description: The facts the library's documents state, typed: id (scrubber.singlePassEfficiency), semantic (SinglePassRemovalEfficiency), quantity, unit, value, a band when the document gives one, and the register property that carries the same fact. A known constant cites one by id (factId); two ratios are not the same fact.

properties.id: one document's facts; all when absent

read.title: Read a document
read.description: One document whole, as markdown, with its sha256.

properties.id: the document's id, from list or search

graphs.title: The graphs on the shelf
graphs.description: The reference graphs a harness may instantiate on the twin, each with its words: what it is and how to use it, its variables (default, bounds, status: known and held, fitted, or a band) and its settings (who is on board), its probes and the telemetry columns they are judged against, the document and the template with their sha256. Instantiate one with graph.evaluate {graph: id, variables, fit, settings}.

properties.grammar: the wording key of your session (_meta.grammar of your initialize, such as claude:en or default:fr); the baseline when absent

graph.title: One graph of the shelf
graph.description: One reference graph whole: its words, its variables, settings and probes, and its template (the parametric spec the harness resolves: node parameters as formulas over the variables, the measured inputs as telemetry columns, the persons of the roster by module).

properties.grammar: the wording key of your session; the baseline when absent

sign.title: Sign a document as reviewed
sign.description: An authorised signatory signs a library document as reviewed, from the control room: the station calls it back with the answer to Mother's question (kind sign, for the role authorised-signatory), or the library page with the digest of what it showed. The signature binds the document, its facts, its rules and its playbook as they are; a safety procedure's limits are justified only by the facts of a signed document, and a playbook conducts only once signed. Refused for anyone the role does not name (specs/station/roles.json). Not a model's to call.

properties.by: who signs: a holder of the role authorised-signatory; the one who answered the question, or the person this machine's git names, when absent
properties.answer: the signatory's answer: sign, or not
properties.digest: the digest of what the person read (review); a document changed since is not signed

signatures_scope.title: Whose signatures
signatures_scope.description: The scenario player's: the repository's signatures (a person's), or a run's own, empty at its start, so a demonstration signs without touching the repository's.

properties.runId: the run, for a run's own

rules.title: A document's rules
rules.description: The rules a guard checks a proposal against, beside the facts of the same document, with the document's signature as it stands: the guard judges only by rules a person signed.

review.title: Review a document before signing
review.description: Every file a signature binds (the document, its facts, its rules), as it is now, with the digest a signature would bind and the signature as it stands: what the library page shows a person before they sign.

propose.title: Propose a playbook
propose.description: The station's, on a factory's proposal: a playbook put on the library's proposals shelf (never in the repository's library), with a document written for the signatory who reads it. It is checked first (it runs, one stage at every event); unsigned, it conducts nothing. Not a model's to call.

properties.id: the proposed document's id, its own
properties.title: its title
properties.summary: what it does and what changed
properties.change: what was asked of the factory
properties.from: the task, the proposal and the sha256 of the file the factory's guard accepted

playbook.title: A playbook, with its signature
playbook.description: A playbook of the library or of its proposals' shelf, whole, with its signature as it stands: what conducts only when a person signed it and it has not changed since.

library://catalogue.name: Catalogue
library://catalogue.description: The documents of the library, with their sha256

library://graphs.name: Graphs
library://graphs.description: The reference graphs on the shelf, with their baseline words
